title: Playboy Exposed: Inside Our Locker Room
original_title: Playboy Exposed: Inside Our Locker Room
overview: It's the world of sports like you've never seen it before! Join us as we take you inside the studio, the gym, and the locker room where a bevy of beauties are stripping out of their uniforms and working up a frenzy. And that's not all, they're also giving a play by play of their party girl rules and regs and telling you what it really means to score!
